stemMarkdown: A rectangular garden 35 m by 27 m is surrounded by a path 4 m wide running all around it on the outside. Find the area (in square m) of the path.
solutionMarkdown: The outer rectangle measures $43$ m by $35$ m, an area of $1505$ square m. Subtracting the garden's $945$ square m leaves $560$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The path widens the plot on both sides, so each dimension grows by twice the width.
